description: Find online stores in Brazil that sell on DMCommerce, by store name or by what they sell (e.g. "jeans", "suplementos", "acessórios 4x4"). Leave query empty to list every store. Returns up to 20 stores with their website and main categories.

query.description: Store name or kind of product, e.g. "Zé Marcos 4x4", "moda infantil", "óculos". Empty lists all stores.
